Sureshwar Thakur, J. (Oral)
1.
Through the instant writ petition, the petitioners claim relief qua the respondent-acquiring authority being directed to restore the possession of the subject lands to the petitioners.

An oral prayer is also made today before this Court by the learned counsel for the petitioners, that since the subject lands are utilized by the respondents, thereby, the respondent concerned be directed to forthwith launch acquisition proceedings for, thereby, bringing the subject lands to lawful acquisition.

He also submits that the said launched acquisition proceedings be so done in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter in short referred to the Act of 2013).

sentences.text: In so far as the controversy which has emerged amongst the contesting litigants before this Court and as it pertains to the subject lands 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:050381-DB becoming utilized by the respondent concerned, the said controversy becomes clinchingly rested from a reading of the reply on affidavit furnished to the instant writ petition by the respondent concerned, wherein, there is a candid echoing that as a matter of fact the subject lands have become utilized for the relevant purpose.

3. The above made candid echoing in the reply to the writ petition furnished by the respondent concerned, does lead this Court, to make a conclusion that therebys the respondents are required to adequately compensating the present petitioners, through just, reasonable and fair compensation becoming assessed in respect of the subject lands, thus, rather by the Collector concerned.
4. Since the Act of 2013 has acquired force from 01.01.2014, as such, the launching of acquisition proceedings vis-a-vis the subject lands is to be done in terms of the Act of 2013.
5. Resultantly, the writ petition is allowed and a mandamus is passed upon the acquiring authority to forthwith, draw a notification, for thereby bringing the subject lands to lawful acquisition.
The said notification be drawn in terms of the Act of 2013.
Moreover, within a period of four months from today, the Collector concerned shall assess just and fair compensation vis-a-vis the subject lands.
6. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
(SURESHWAR THAKUR)
JUDGE 15.04.2024 (LALIT BATRA)
